test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of five students in a class test is 39.20 and the average of three of them is 41. What is the average of the remaining two students?
solution:
Given:

Average marks of 5 students = 39.20

And average of three of them is 41.

Concept used:

Average = Sum of element/Number of element

Calculation:

Total marks of 5 students

= 39.20 × 5

= 196

Total marks of 3 students

= 41 × 3

= 123

Average of the remaining 2 students 

= (196-123)/(2)

= (73)/(2)

= 36.5

∴ The average of remaining 2 students is 36.5.
